subject: Azure Marketplace SKU mapping, ARM template validation, and lightweight runbook for NimbusTech
messages:
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>; Jessica Park <jessica@nimbustechnology.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace SKU mapping, ARM template validation, and lightweight runbook for NimbusTech

Hi Jessica / Azure team —

Following our call earlier this week, attaching the SKU mapping draft and an ARM snippet we used in staging. The ask from Nimbus is twofold:

1) Confirm the SKU->Plan mapping aligns with co-sell tagging requirements (they want co-sell eligible SKUs for two tiers).
2) Validate the ARM snippet and minimal policy checks so their CI pipeline can run a dry deploy in the publisher sandbox.

Attachments: nimbus_sku_map_v1.xlsx (SKU / plan mapping), azure_arm_snippet.json (deployment snippet), marketplace_publish_runbook_v0.2.md (internal runbook).

Short notes on the map: we created three SKUs (Free, Standard, Enterprise) and included metering SKU ids and co-sell boolean. Nimbus prefers to alias the Standard SKU to their "Team" pricing label in the UI — we can do that, but want to confirm any co-sell metadata limitations.

Next steps I propose:
- Azure team: quick pass on co-sell metadata + required manifest fields (by EOD tomorrow PST).
- Nimbus: run the attached ARM snippet in sandbox and share deployment logs (we can triage).
- Redwood: Marissa / Karthik to own the manifest generation and publish checklist.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short sync if that helps.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
---

From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>; Jessica Park <jessica@nimbustechnology.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace SKU mapping, ARM template validation, and lightweight runbook for NimbusTech

Hi Dylan / Jessica —

Thanks for these artifacts, useful layout. Two quick items from our side:

1) Co-sell tagging: We require the manifest to include coSellEligible: true at the plan level and the planId must match your SKU identifier. We can accept aliasing in the UI as long as the underlying planId is stable.

2) ARM snippet: suggest adding a resourceProviderAuthorization block for Microsoft.MarketplaceOrdering to avoid telemetry errors at validation time. See notes inline in the attached ARM snippet.

We'll do a sandbox dry-run on Monday morning (PST) and post the deployment results to the publisher portal link you shared. If anything fails we'll attach the full error payload.

Regards,
Anu Patel
Marketplace Onboarding Engineer
Microsoft
[Attachment: arm_snippet_review_notes.txt]
